async def act(page):
    # Fill the textbox with 'Jakub Klinkovský' and wait for autocomplete suggestions
    members_textbox = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Select members to invite")
    await members_textbox.fill("Jakub Klinkovský")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for autocomplete dropdown to appear
    # Press down arrow and Enter to select the first suggestion, if available
    await members_textbox.press("ArrowDown")
    await members_textbox.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for UI update
    
    # Fill the textbox with 'Benoît Blanchon' and wait for autocomplete suggestions
    await members_textbox.fill("Benoît Blanchon")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(2000)  # Wait for autocomplete dropdown to appear
    # Press down arrow and Enter to select the first suggestion, if available
    await members_textbox.press("ArrowDown")
    await members_textbox.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for UI update
    
    # Ensure the role is set to 'Developer' (it is selected by default, but confirm)
    role_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Choose a role permission")
    await role_combobox.select_option("Developer")
    
    # Click the 'Add to project' button after it becomes enabled
    add_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Add to project")
    await add_button.click()
    
    # Wait for any network activity to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
